body: 2026-10-16. A login whose provider does not fit, coming from AGX_LOGIN or a provider default, is skipped with a note (a non-fitting provider default silently); it is an error only when given by --login or a profile's login:. An unknown AGX_LOGIN name is an error. Why: an exported Claude login must not break every Codex command.
title: Logins D11: wrong-provider login from env/default is skipped
